commons.title: J20150605-0006—Arctostaphylos uva-ursi X (Humboldt mystery manzanita)—RPBG (17998226283).jpg
commons.credit: John Rusk from Berkeley, CA, United States of America
commons.description: Humboldt Mystery Manzanita. The label says "Collected by J. Roof in a Secret Place."  James Roof was the first director of the Regional Parks Botanic Garden and a manzanita aficionado. The mystery manzanita was collected in the early 1940s.  The red berry tells us that one of the parents was Arctostaphylos uva-ursi, which is usually prostrate or nearly so.  The upright habit of this collection leaves a wide range of possibilities as to the other parent.  Photographed at the Regional Parks Botanic Garden in Tilden Regional Park near Berkeley, CA.
commons.editorial_reason: Generic manzanita plant with no Yavapai attribution or cultural content.
